tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan bzhugs// ༄༅// rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi mkhyen brtse phul byung zhing*// mthu dang phrin las mtha' yas pas// rtag par gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i// 'gro ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal// blo gsal bla ma la gus pa// dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya ba yis// bsam pa dge bas dris pa'i lan// dri med lung bzhin 'dir bshad bya// shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i// dus ni bskal pa grangs med sngon// 'dir ni tshe lo brgya pa la// byang chub brnyes pa sprul pa yin// rjod byed rab byed 'dus pa yis// brjod bya'i rnam grangs mang ston pa'i// ngag rgyun gcig gis bsdus pa'i gzhung*// phung po nyid yin de yi tshad// gcig tu nges pa yod ma yin// spang bya nyon mongs gsum spong zhing*// brjod bya bslab pa gsum ston pa'i// rjod byed sde snod rnam pa gsum// so so ba dang spyir ston pa// brgyad khri bzhi stong yod ces grags// byang chub sems kyi gzhi brten nas// stong nyid snying rje'i lam gyis ni// spangs rtogs phun tshogs bcu gcig pa// sgrub pa pha rol phyin pa'i lugs// smin byed dbang gi gzhi bzung nas// rim gnyis yan lag bcas pa yis// spangs rtogs bde chen bcu gsum pa// sgrub pa sngags kyi rnam gzhag yin// bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// gdul bya mchog la gsang sngags gsungs// mtshan brjod dgongs pa de nyid yin// thun mong pa yi 'khor rnams la// shākya thub pa kho nas gsungs// gsang 'dus dgongs pa 'di yin no// gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang bzhin du// sngon tshe thub pas sprul pa yi// dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul mdzad nas// lha dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin dang*// mkha' 'gro sogs la gsal bar bshad// de dag rnams kyis skal ldan gyi// mi rnams la ni so so yi// skal ba ji bzhin smin byas nas// rgyud dang man ngag so sor gsungs// de dag rnams las rab brgyud nas// mi yi yul du gsal bar gyur// 'di yi dbye ba dpag med phyir// 'di snyed do zhes sus brjod spobs// de lta mod kyi bla med tshul// phal cher nub phyogs au rgyan du// in+d+ra bhū tis gsal bar byas// rgyud sde 'og ma phal che ba// 'phags pa'i yul gyi shar lho ru// rab gsal zla ba zhes bya yi// rgyal po mchog gis gsal bar byas// tsi lu pa la sogs pa las// sham+bha la la sogs pa ru// 'phags pa rnams las thos pa'i tshul// kun tu gsal bar byas pa yod// phri dang bsnan pas 'phel 'grib bcas// tshad ldan pa la 'thad pa ste// sems can grangs la tshad med phyir// grol bas nyung bar ga la 'gyur// srid pa bar dor brdzus te skye// skye 'gyur las kyi gzhan dbang ste// de yi bag chags sngar sad phyir// gang du skye 'gyur byad gzugs can// gal te gang zag gzhan gyi mthus// skye ba yongs su sgyur byed na// gang du bsgyur ba de gzugs su// de yang yongs su 'gyur ba can// dus ni phal cher zhag bdun no// bdun phrag bdun pa'ang yod ces grags// las kyi 'phen pa drag zhan gyis// mtshams med pa'ang 'byung 'gyur zhing*// lo dang bskal par gnas pa'ang bshad// de phyir gcig tu nges pa med// sdug bsngal ba la sdug bsngal dang*// stong pa nyid la stong nyid dang*// bde ba la ni bde ba'i rgyur// shes na tshe 'di'i 'khri ba ci// nus pa yod na chos bzhin du// gzhan don brtson las bstan pa'i rgyun// gnas par byed pa bla ma dang*// rgyal ba mnyes byed dang po yin// gzhan don bsgrub pa'i mthu dman na// bsgrub la brtson pa rang don la// gzhol ba mnyes byed gnyis pa ste// zang zing mchod pa gsum pa yin// dang po sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*// gzhan don bsgrub na bshad nyan bya// phyi nas rtogs pa bskyed pa dang*// rang gi don la sgrub pa mchog

/khyod dang khyod 'dra gang yin pas// bsgrub la nan tan bya bar rigs// dngos gzhi bsam gtan bzlas brjod brtson// skyo dang the tshom bsal ba dang*// dad dang ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir// bar skabs dag tu gzhung lugs blta// klog pa dang ni kha ton pas// bzlas brjod phan yon che bar gsungs// dam tshig sdom pa'i gzhi brtan zhing*// bskyed pa'i rim la mnyam bzhag nas// rjes thob bdag gzhan lhar rig pas// longs spyod pa yi mchod pas mchod// sngags kyis rgyal ba'i thugs bskul zhing*// dge kun gzhan gyi don dmigs nas// smon lam bzang pos yongs bsgyur ba// rgya chen bsgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// rang sems gdod nas rnam dag pa// bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis med par// shes nas rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa// zab mo bsgrub pa'i rim pa yin// lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs// shin tu zab mo yod mod kyi// bsgrub par dga' zhing gegs mang phyir// re zhig mos pa tsam du bya// tho rangs rlung sems dwangs pa'i phyir// zab mo'i ting 'dzin bsgom par bya// langs nas khrus sogs sngon 'gro bas// yan lag bdun pas bdag rgyud sbyangs// chos bzhin kha zas legs spyad de// nyin par kha ton bzlas brjod dang*// gtor ma chu sbyin la sogs pa// gtso bor lus ngag dge sbyor bya// srod la thub pas bdud btul phyir// srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan bsgoms nas// rim gnyis bzlas bcas sngon 'gro bas// mdun gyi ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor las// dbang bskur rin chen blang bar bya// nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i// 'chi kha ma yi gdams ngag ni// gnyid log tshe na bsgom bya zhing*// 'dun pa sngon du 'gro ba yis// rmi lam na yang chos rnams kun// rmi lam nyid du shes bya zhing*// der yang lha dang bla ma dang*// bdag nyid rjes su dran par bya// sad pa'i tshe na 'od gsal las// zung 'jug chen por ldang bar bya// dus rnams kun du bla ma dang*// 'bral med lam gyi snying po yin// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'dis// rnal 'byor dus kun 'da' bar bya// bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyi// khye'us khye'u 'byin pa bzhin// rtog pas rtog pa sel ba'i phyir// grol ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin no// rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i rjes// ye shes lnga yi mtshon byed yin// 'di yi rgyu mtshan mang yod kyi// mdor bsdus de tsam shes par gyis// ye shes lnga ni mtshon pa'i phyir// rigs lnga mchog gi sprul pa ste// gdul bya mchog la de ltar snang*// longs skur bshad pa mchog la dgongs// rigs lnga dge sbyong cha lugs so// dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ba thos// lung las bshad pa ngas ma mthong*// 'on kyang de nyid bsdus pa las// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ji ltar dga' ba'i sku dang ni// cha lugs can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// dge sbyong tshul la'ang 'gal ba med// sangs rgyas rigs lnga re re yang*// ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can// ye shes re re gzhan don gyis// dbye na tshad med bzhi bzhi po// de phyir de dag rigs rnams brgya// 'di ni 'bras bus dbye ba ste// rgyu dang lam yang 'dis dpyad bya// zhi ba'i lha ni bzhi bcu gnyis// khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la// dam pa rigs brgya yin no zhes// rnying ma pa rnams smra mod kyi// 'phags pa'i yul las byung ba yi// rgyud sde rnams las de ma grags// rgyal po'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid la// rnam pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung ba// sgrub po'i las kyi dngos grub la// nye ring 'byung zhing de yang ni// thun mong lha la sgrol ma dang*// thun mong ma yin bde ba'i mchog

/shin tu bsgrub thag nye'o zhes// bla ma mchog gi gsung las 'byung*// sgrol ma la sogs thun mong gi /dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha ru gsungs// dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa// mchog gi go 'phang thob byed yin// dbang phyug brgyad ni zla grags kyis// rnam gzhag gzhan du bshad mod kyi// phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dag pa ni// mi thub zla ba'i zhal snga nas// sa ni dang po nor sbyin mthar// zhes gsungs don ni 'byung bzhi dang*// nyi zla tshe dang nor rnams la// dbang sgyur brgyad ni dbang phyug brgyad// bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gsungs pa// bdag ni sgrub po nyid yin te// rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin du 'dod// ting 'dzin bskyed pa'i gegs bsal phyir// rnal 'byor srung bar gsungs pa yin// gnas ni gang du bsgrub pa'i yul// lha yi dmigs pa gsal ba'i thabs// spyan sogs sku yi cha shas la// goms par byas te slob pa dang*// bris pa la sogs me long la// shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs te// de dang 'dra bar bsgoms pa yis// rim gyis dmigs pa gsal bar 'gyur// rgyas par gzhan las shes par gyis// snying rje bde ba bsgom pa dang*// kha na ma tho med pa yi// 'dod pa'i yon tan spyad pa dang*// chos kyi gtam dang mdo sogs la// lta bas skyo ba bsal bar bya// ji ltar 'os pa'ang rang gis spyad// nad dang zug rngu glo bur gyi// nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por ni// stong nyid ting 'dzin mchog yin zhes// lhag bsam dag pa'i mdo las gsungs// rang lus lha yi grong khyer nas// bla ma rigs kyi bdag po yi// sku yi gzhal med yid 'ong bar// snying po chu skyes gdan steng du// glog gi tshul gyis rab 'jug cing*// dbyings la ye shes ji bzhin du// skar mda'i tshul gyis 'dres gyur nas// mi rtog ngang la mnyam 'jog pa// dus rnams kun du bsgom par bya// goms nas nying mtshams sbyor tshe brtsams// 'di shes pa la 'chi ba dang*// gshin rje'i 'jigs pa gyi na yin// theg pa che la blo log nas// theg dman kho nar zhugs gyur na// ji srid de las ma log pa// de srid de yi gegs su 'gyur// mthar thug 'phags pa gnyis ka yang*// sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes// dam chos pad+ma dkar la sogs// nges pa'i don gyi mdo las gsungs// so so'i thar pa'i sdom pa sogs// theg chen lam gyi yan lag tu// byed na de yi grogs su 'gyur// phal cher kun slong dbang yin no// dmigs med snying rje mtshan nyid pa// rab dga'i sa la skye bar bshad// cha mthun da ltar 'byung ba'ang srid// mthar phyin sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig la// chos sku rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te// longs sku tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras// sprul sku de yi rnam 'phrul yin// mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag bshad pa mang*// tshul khrims byang sems dam tshig gsum// gzhi yin phyir na brtan par bya// dad dang snying rje smon pa gsum// sngon 'gro yin phyir sngon du bsgom// lha dang bla ma rang rig gsum// dngos gzhi yin phyir mnyam par gzhag

/bsngo ba smon lam rjes dran gsum// mjug sdud yin phyir mjug tu spyad// sgyu ma stong nyid zung 'jug gsum// khyab byed yin phyir kun rgyas gdab// gsum tshan lnga ru spel ba yis// chos tshul bcu dang lnga phrag gcig /rjes su slob pa'i gang zag la// nor gyi snying por byin pa yin// de ltar khyod kyis nga la dris pa'i lan// dri med lung gi tshul bzhin bshad pa yis// dge ba gang des 'gro ba ma lus kun// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ldan gyi yul du skyes pa'i blo gsal ba'i dge slong dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya bas dris pa la/ 'phags pas lan btab pa'i rab tu byed pa/ shing pho byi ba'i lo ston zla rwa ba'i tshes nyi shu gcig la mtshal mdor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// 'di gsang sngags kyi tshul gtso cher 'byung bas/ dbang ma thob pa rnams la bstan par mi bya'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
